convex:deviceCodes.notes: CLI pairing codes become unusable 15 minutes after creation. A scheduled sweep removes up to 256 expired records each minute; a backlog may need multiple sweeps. Only digests of the code and polling secret are stored.

convex:publishCredentials.notes: SHA-256 token digests only. Active credentials persist until explicit revocation; historical accounts above 20 keep their existing credentials while new issuance is blocked. Revoked records become eligible for hourly cleanup after 30 days, at most 256 per sweep; backlog can extend retention. Logout does not delete the account or its packets.

convex:personProfiles.notes: Authoritative reviewed public packets keyed by accountId and handle. Both live and withdrawn packets count toward 200 retained profiles and 20 MiB canonical bytes/account. Existing over-budget data is retained; updates can hold or reduce retained bytes. Direct backend compatibility permits identical restore or shrinking of an existing packet above 512 KiB, while HTTP/CLI request bytes stay absolutely capped. Withdrawal hides public reads but retains the packet and does not release storage quota. Identical live packets are write-free no-ops. Full packets remain inline in Convex: existing content-store separation debt, not a newly provisioned blob service.

convex:personProfileMetadata.notes: Rebuildable public locator, summary, digest/revision, visibility and packet/projection byte metadata. Written atomically with meaningful publication; withdrawals hide the retained projection. Public enumeration reads metadata without whole packets.

convex:personProfileGraph.notes: Rebuildable graph, theme and question projection. Existing projections above 64 KiB are preserved by migration and may retain or shrink their byte size; identical-packet restore is also allowed despite timestamp-only byte-count changes. Public pages are bounded; no source references are truncated to fit. Withdrawal hides the retained projection.

convex:personPublisherVersions.notes: Publisher-scoped generation for consistent HTML related-profile page traversal. Incremented transactionally with meaningful publication and real withdrawal; a rename advances both old and new usernames. Identical live publishes and repeated withdrawals do not write. Retained without TTL or reset so a changed-then-restored corpus cannot reuse an earlier generation. Missing counter reads as zero; no migration backfill is required. This does not make public corpus API pages an atomic snapshot. Durable correctness state, not a disposable projection. There is no implemented account-deletion or counter-reset flow; any future account removal must preserve the generation safety boundary.

convex:personAccountUsage.notes: Transactional publication admission state: retained row/byte totals plus token-bucket state. Totals are reconstructible from retained packets, but resetting the rate bucket changes admission and is not a routine rebuild. No self-service account deletion is implemented; withdrawal retains totals and consumes no token.

convex:personProjectionState.notes: Durable versioned migration cursor, ready marker and explicit activation marker. Internal backfill is additive and idempotent; it never deletes packets. Read-only indexed coverage must pass before people:activateProjections enables projection-dependent reads. Keep checkpoints for safe retry and recovery.

route:/site/app/[username]/[handle].notes: Full profile remains readable when publisher-context lookup is incomplete, unavailable, or changes between pages. Related-profile identity joins require complete context with an identical publisher generation on every page; otherwise a notice replaces joins.

route:/site/app/api/v1/index.json.notes: Cursor-paginated, non-atomic public projection pages. Shared cache lifetime 30 seconds without stale-while-revalidate; withdrawn summaries/projections can persist for that window. PAGE_TOO_LARGE rejects oversized output without truncation.

route:/site/app/api/v1/graph.json.notes: Cursor-paginated, non-atomic public projection pages. Shared cache lifetime 30 seconds without stale-while-revalidate; withdrawn summaries/projections can persist for that window. PAGE_TOO_LARGE rejects oversized output without truncation.

route:/site/app/api/v1/themes.json.notes: Cursor-paginated, non-atomic public projection pages. Shared cache lifetime 30 seconds without stale-while-revalidate; withdrawn summaries/projections can persist for that window. PAGE_TOO_LARGE rejects oversized output without truncation.

route:/site/app/api/v1/questions.json.notes: Cursor-paginated, non-atomic public projection pages. Shared cache lifetime 30 seconds without stale-while-revalidate; withdrawn summaries/projections can persist for that window. PAGE_TOO_LARGE rejects oversized output without truncation.

route:/site/app/sitemap.notes: Bounded discovery from the first metadata page; larger corpora return that subset without throwing. Complete public enumeration uses index.json cursor pages.

route:/site/app/examples.notes: Static curated examples with browser-local search and category filters; no database reads.

assets:example-portraits.notes: Source-derived graphite sketches for the curated people examples. Public source attribution, processing metadata, and hashes accompany each asset.

provider:gateway-exa-discovery.notes: Explicit optional paid public discovery only. Uses an existing AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and a chosen model; no automatic file ingestion, installation, persistence, redirects, or retries. Gateway owns its search loop, so one HTTP request can cause multiple paid tool calls; use a provider API-key spending budget. Timeout does not cancel provider billing. Output is unverified model-written candidate discovery, not raw Exa evidence.
